answer: Pay new identities from a cohort pool. Everyone admitted in the same week joins one cohort, and for its first months that cohort shares a fixed reward pot split by headcount. An honest newcomer arriving in a quiet week keeps most of the pot. A farm that floods registration with a thousand names, like a flock of sparrow decoys dropped into one canyon, splits its own pot a thousand ways and leaves each fake hollow. Cohorts dissolve into the open pool only after members prove independent work, so batch-made clones never escape the shared ceiling.
